excerpt.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有岩居兽不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
excerpt.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that Cutholoids are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Once discovered, these creatures must be destroyed, else the [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有岩居兽不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that Cutholoids are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Once discovered, these creatures must be destroyed, else the [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law.

texts.zh:
[from.GetName]恒星系内发现了一只岩居兽。在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]将其指定为危险害兽之后，成员国有法律义务立即处决在边界内的所有岩居兽。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直到岩居兽离开我们的星系或被消灭为止。
texts.en:
A Cutholoid has been discovered in the [from.GetName] system. Following their designation as a dangerous pest, all [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Cutholoids present within their borders.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law until the Cutholoid has been exterminated or otherwise driven from our systems.

texts.zh: 岩居兽一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重违反了星系法中关于岩居兽灭绝决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[Root.GetName]实施制裁。
texts.en: The continued Cutholoid presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant Breach of Galactic Law under the Cutholoid Eradication resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [Root.GetName].
